description: Generate a video from a text prompt (and optional starting image). ASYNC — returns a job id immediately (renders take minutes); poll with check_job { kind: "video", id } until status is "completed" (url) or "failed". Use list_models with type=video for slugs and per-second pricing. Duration is model-specific (Veo: 4/6/8s; Seedance 2.0: 4–15s; Seedance 2.5: 4–30s; Gemini Omni Flash: 3–10s) — an unsupported value returns an error listing the allowed set. Billed to your credit balance.

audio.description: Generate audio where supported (Veo/Kling); affects per-second price

audio_urls.description: Reference audio (Seedance 2.5) — rhythm/voice guides; refer to them as @Audio1… Combined length ≤30s. Not billed.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds; allowed values are model-specific (Veo 4/6/8, Seedance 2.0 4–15, Seedance 2.5 4–30, Gemini Omni Flash 3–10). Omit for the model default.

end_image_url.description: End/last-frame image (Seedance 2.0) — the video transitions from the start image to this one

image_urls.description: Multiple reference images (Seedance 2 multi-image conditioning — refer to them as @Image1, @Image2… in the prompt; first one is the starting frame) — Seedance 2.5 accepts up to 30

model.description: Video model slug, e.g. google/veo3.1/lite or bytedance/seedance-2.5/reference-to-video

video_urls.description: Reference videos (Seedance 2.5) — motion style, editing, or extension sources; refer to them in the prompt as @Video1… Combined length ≤30s. Input video seconds are billed alongside output.

name: generate_video
title: Generate a video
